interface.signature: def addBinary(A: str, B: str) -> str:

preconditions.description: Both inputs A and B must be strings.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in A) and all(c in '01' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both strings must consist only of characters '0' and '1'.
The lengths of A and B must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The integer value of the returned string must equal the sum of the integer values of A and B interpreted as binary numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The returned string must consist only of characters '0' and '1'.
The returned string must not have leading zeros, except for the single digit '0' if the sum is zero.
